messages:
Lia Chen: Quick check — NZ-east private-connect cutover dependencies. Trying to get owners for the remaining items before tomorrow's smoke. TL;DR: VPC peering, KMS key enablement, egress firewall, and PR for route policy.
Andrew Park: I can own VPC peering and route table changes. Will open a PR in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Marisol Vega: I can take KMS key policy + IAM bindings. Need to confirm key rotation policy with security. pinging @security for any extra constraints. :eyes:
Samir Patel: I'm tied up until 3pm PT but can own egress/firewall (NZ egress whitelist). Which CIDR ranges do we need for private-connect? I only have the cloud provider list.
Lia Chen: Thanks. CIDRs are in the runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/nz-east-privconnect (see section 2.1). Also we need to ensure logs are exported to the central S3 prefix /redwood-regions/nz-east/
Marisol Vega: security says key policy must include: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt for service accounts used by runtime; and logging to audit account. I'll add that to the PR. Also, note we must not enable external key access (no key policy for cloud-managed accounts).
Andrew Park: opened PR 4623: "nz-east: peering + route-policy". Short summary in PR description. @Lia Chen please add the smoke checklist items to the PR so CI can run the terraform plan.
Lia Chen: added smoke checklist and canary flags to the PR. Also added this quick commands snippet for testing connectivity locally:
```
# run from bastion in NZ-east
curl -v http://10.10.2.5:8080/health
traceroute 10.10.2.5
``` 
Samir Patel: For firewall, I need the outbound destination ports. Runtime likes 443 + 2200 for ops tunnel. Confirmed with infra: 2200 is used for debug tunnels, will include that.
infra-bot: Resource provisioning status: peering-request NZE-REQ-789 queued; route-policy queued; kms-key pending. ETA: ~45m.
Lia Chen: Action items recap: (1) Andrew: merge PR 4623 after infra-bot shows peering active; (2) Marisol: PR for KMS policy (assign to security for review); (3) Samir: update firewall rules + test from bastion; (4) Lia: run smoke once infra-bot reports green. If anyone needs more time, say now.
Samir Patel: I'll do firewall + smoke tests, will post results here. :ok_hand:
Marisol Vega: KMS PR will be up by EOD NZ time. tagging @security for review.
Andrew Park: If CI fails on terraform plan due to provider limits, i'll fallback to manual route apply and coordinate with infra team. FYI PR 4623 includes a small helper script:
```
# quick apply for test env
tf plan -var-file=nz-test.tfvars
tf apply -auto-approve
```
Lia Chen: Great. Thanks team. If infra-bot shows anything unexpected, I'll escalate to platform oncall. Otherwise we'll reconvene on the ops doc thread after smoke. :white_check_mark:
